description: Use when you need a historical exchange-rate series or a period summary (e.g. USD/KRW over the last quarter). Input: symbols (1–10), base (default EUR), start and end (YYYY-MM-DD since 1999-01-04; default last 30 days; max 366 days). Output: JSON daily series of ECB fixings, and per currency first/last, % change, min/max with dates, average and daily volatility. Source: ECB statistics; reference only. Example: ?base=USD&symbols=KRW,JPY&start=2026-07-01&end=2026-09-30 Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

end.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD (default today; range ≤ 366 days)

start.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (default end minus 30 days; earliest 1999-01-04)

name: fx_history
title: FX history (ECB): daily rate series for up to 10 currencies, any base, up to 366 days, with stats
